title: Srimad Mahabharata Part 1: Adi Parva (The Book of the Beginning) | Full Cinematic Movie | Divya Mangalam
description:
Experience the majestic story of Srimad Mahabharata as chronicled by Maharshi Veda Vyasa and Lord Ganesha.

Part 1: The Adi Parva (The Book of the Beginning) captures the cosmic origins, Prince Devavrata's earth-shaking oath (Bhishma Pratigya), Guru Dronacharya's archery test and Arjuna's unrivaled focus, the treacherous burning of the House of Lac (Lakshagriha), Arjuna winning Draupadi at her Swayamvara by piercing the Matsya Yantra, and the founding of Indraprastha with the celestial Gandiva bow.

⏳ CHAPTER TIMESTAMPS:
00:00 - CHAPTER 1: THE DIVINE ORIGIN & MAHARSHI VYASA
00:37 - CHAPTER 2: BHISHMA PITAMAHA & THE TERRIBLE VOW
01:28 - CHAPTER 3: GURU DRONA & ARJUNA'S UNRIVALED FOCUS
02:19 - CHAPTER 4: THE CONSPIRACY OF LAKSHAGRIHA & THE ESCAPE
03:01 - CHAPTER 5: DRAUPADI SWAYAMVARA & THE MATSYA YANTRA
03:56 - CHAPTER 6: INDRAPRASTHA & THE DIVINE GANDIVA BOW
